# Explain Your Reason for Changing Roles and Your Interest in the Team

[← Rippling](../README.md) · [Every Rippling question](../../rippling.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/explain-your-reason-for-changing-roles-and-your-interest-in-the-team)

---

Why are you considering a job change now, and what attracts you to this role or company?
### Constraints & Assumptions
Anchor your response in your own motivations and link them to what you have actually confirmed about the opening. Do not fabricate details about the culture, team scope, or personal drivers. Keep the tone professional and centered on mutual fit.
### Clarifying Questions
What are you looking for that your current position does not provide? What can you deliver right away? Which aspects of the opportunity have you validated, and what still needs exploration?
### What a Strong Answer Covers
A clear rationale for the timing, concrete criteria for the role, demonstrated alignment, and genuine questions about remaining trade-offs.
### Follow-up Questions
What would convince you to remain where you are? Which responsibilities carry the most weight for you? What new information could shift your perspective on this opportunity?
Overview:
Articulate your reason for moving and your interest in the role through specific goals, evidence of fit, a professional frame, and honest open questions.
